title: nan
authors: Wang Z.; Wang H.; Liu S.
key_contribution: Presents an adaptive particle filter-neural network fusion framework for cooperative localization of multi-UAV systems in GNSS-denied indoor environments, validated in six-UAV simulations.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Radio_Based_Positioning to ensure precise positioning.
